# Contributing to Broccoli

Thanks for your interest in Broccoli. Here is how you can help.

## Issues are open to everyone

Found a bug, have an idea, or got stuck? [Open an issue](../../issues/new/choose).
Bug reports with clear steps to reproduce are the most useful thing you can
send us.

Security problems are the exception: report them privately, as described in
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Pull requests are limited to the team

For now, only maintainers can open pull requests. We are a small team building
fast, and we would rather say so plainly than leave pull requests unanswered.
Before we open pull requests to everyone, we will put a contributor licence
agreement in place.

If you want to change something, open an issue and describe it. We read every
one.

## How the team works

- **Pull request titles follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org):**
  `type(scope): summary`, where `type` is one of `feat`, `fix`, `perf`,
  `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `build`, `ci` or `chore`. A check rejects other
  titles. The title becomes the commit on `main` and the changelog line.
- **Squash merges only**, so `main` stays linear: one reviewed pull request,
  one commit.
- **Signed commits.** `main` accepts only signed commits.
- **Release notes.** Every pull request fills in the Release Notes line of the
  template. Self-hosting operators read them before they update.
- **AI tools** are welcome; see [AI_POLICY.md](AI_POLICY.md).

## Code of conduct

Everyone taking part follows our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
